{'index': 0, 'text': 'The highly anticipated Apple TV+ series "Ted Lasso" is currently in the midst of its fourth season, with a very enthusiastic response — but there are still three exciting new shows about to land on the platform.'}

{'index': 1, 'text': 'Show one: Dark Matter'}

{'index': 2, 'text': "Apple TV+ has a vast library of excellent shows for sci-fi fans to binge-watch to their heart's content. Severance and Pluribus have already become the talk of the town, but there's another beloved series that may have flown under the radar: Dark Matter."}

{'index': 3, 'text': "The series is adapted from Blake Crouch's bestselling novel and stars Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly."}

{'index': 4, 'text': 'Season 2 of Dark Matter will premiere on Friday, August 28, with new episodes dropping weekly through October 30.'}

{'index': 5, 'text': "Here's the synopsis provided by Apple:"}

{'index': 6, 'text': 'Show two: Mayday'}

{'index': 7, 'text': "Apple TV+'s fall lineup is quite robust, with most titles going straight to streaming rather than debuting in theaters first."}

{'index': 8, 'text': 'Kicking things off is Mayday, an action-comedy starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh that puts a fresh spin on the classic spy thriller genre.'}

{'index': 9, 'text': 'Mayday will debut exclusively on Apple TV+ on Friday, September 4.'}

{'index': 10, 'text': "Here's the synopsis and trailer provided by Apple:"}

{'index': 11, 'text': 'Show three: Slow Horses'}

{'index': 12, 'text': "One of Apple's most acclaimed series, Slow Horses, is set to return."}

{'index': 13, 'text': 'In the streaming era, fans often have to wait several years between seasons of their favourite shows. But Slow Horses has kept up a yearly release cadence, with Gary Oldman as Jackson Lamb leading the team through another gripping chapter of spy action.'}

{'index': 14, 'text': 'Season 6 of Slow Horses will premiere on Wednesday, September 16, with new episodes dropping weekly through October 21.'}

{'index': 15, 'text': 'Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, and is also available at a discount through the Apple One bundle subscription.'}
